answer: Each node commits unique Blake3 hashes over dedicated 4 GB RAM arrays, locking an epoch state root before issuance. Verifiers re-derive roots and probe pseudo-random offsets; any ember of stale or duplicated identity collapses the round. Cheap clones fail because replicating one honest array across 10,000 fakes forces a spiral of memory cost near $180,000 monthly, each forged root seeding a detectable ripple across epochs.
